name: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level v4.0 (syllabus areas)
notice: Reference checklist assembled by the REX AI team from the framework's publicly known area names. The wording and search keywords are the team's, NOT the issuer's text, and nothing here has been verified by the issuer. Use it to find possible gaps; check the official source before relying on it.

areas.title: Fundamentals of Testing
areas.expected_outcome: Explain the objectives, principles and process of software testing and its relation to quality.

areas.title: Testing Throughout the Software Development Lifecycle
areas.expected_outcome: Place testing activities correctly inside agile and DevOps delivery pipelines and across test levels.

areas.title: Static Testing
areas.expected_outcome: Apply reviews and static analysis to find defects before code is executed.

areas.title: Test Analysis and Design
areas.expected_outcome: Derive test conditions and test cases using black-box, white-box and experience-based techniques.

areas.title: Managing the Test Activities
areas.expected_outcome: Plan, monitor and report test activities, manage risk and defects.

areas.title: Test Tools
areas.expected_outcome: Select and use tools that support test management and automation.
